profile.summary: BN Agrochem Limited manufactures and trades agricultural commodities, oilseeds, edible oils, and related products. The company offers refined soyabean oils, sunflower oils, mustard oils, rapeseed oils, crude palm oils, and crude soyabean oils, as well as provides solvent extraction, extracted oil cakes, refined oils and oleochemicals, fats, and glycerine-based pharma products.
